_how_to: One entry per partner. name, url (https), logo (file name in public/assets/partners/) and summary (one sentence). approved is true once Don has confirmed the partner agreed to be listed and the sentence is right. An entry with a field missing is drawn as a draft card. tests/test_partners.py fails while any entry is incomplete or not approved, so neither can ship. Logo sources: ../Alphaworx Business/Marketing/alphaworx.io/partner-logos/source/. The first three entries: partners agreed to be listed and sentences approved, Don, Nov 25, 2026.
